description.value: Every settlement wants a story about somewhere else, and you've got a hundred of them, half true. You can Earn Income using Performance in any settlement regardless of its size, ignoring the normal population requirement for your proficiency rank.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule-element key bypasses Earn Income's settlement-size/population requirement for a given proficiency rank -- that gating is baked into the Earn Income activity itself, not exposed to a predicate.
